recipe.build:
wget -q -O /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip -- https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.14.0/node-v24.14.0-linux-x64.tar.xz
sha256sum -c <<< '41cd79bb7877c81605a9e68ec4c91547774f46a40c67a17e34d7179ef11729df  /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip'
tar xf /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip -C /opt
export PATH="${PATH}:/opt/node-v24.14.0-linux-x64/bin:${HOME}/.node/bin"
export GRADLE_USER_HOME=/opt/gradle
npm install
npm run build
npx cap sync android
cd android
./gradlew assembleRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

sha256sum -c <<< '472655581fb851559730c48763e0c9d3bc25975c59d518003fc0849d3e4ba0f6  /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip'
tar xf /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip -C /opt
export PATH="${PATH}:/opt/node-v24.15.0-linux-x64/bin:${HOME}/.node/bin"
export GRADLE_USER_HOME=/opt/gradle
npm install
npm run build
npx cap sync android
cd android
./gradlew assembleRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

sha256sum -c <<< 'd804845d34eddc21dc1092b519d643ef40b1f58ec5dec5c22b1f4bd8fabde6c9  /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip'
tar xf /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip -C /opt
export PATH="${PATH}:/opt/node-v24.16.0-linux-x64/bin:${HOME}/.node/bin"
export GRADLE_USER_HOME=/opt/gradle
npm install
export REACT_APP_VERSION="$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
npm run build
npx cap sync android
cd android
./gradlew assembleRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
